name: Burgohondo (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper fly, blue above and yellow below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Burgohondo (a church, roundels and a bridge).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 25 March 1999 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 67 of 12 April 1999); the flag is described as square, in blue and gold divided diagonally, with the arms of Burgohondo at the centre.

features.role: Burgohondo arms — church, roundels and bridge
